key_insight: CFP AI is shifting from image-only models to multimodal systems, driven by co-evolution in datasets, preprocessing, and model design.
clinical_relevance: This progression could improve large-scale screening, cross-domain generalization, and richer clinical reasoning by combining fundus images with EHR and longitudinal patient data.
method: Reviewed how CFP datasets evolved from small single-center sets to large multi-center, multimodal, longitudinal resources.
Summarized preprocessing trends from classical enhancement to neural pipelines, token optimization, and self-supervised EHR imputation.
Compared modeling progress from CNNs to foundation models, state space models, and multimodal expert architectures.
evidence_signal: The review highlights a broad shift in available data and evaluation scope, including multi-center datasets, multimodal pairings, and longitudinal clinical records.
watch_item: Clinical deployment still depends on careful coordination of data quality, preprocessing, and model integration, especially when EHRs are incomplete or cross-site generalization is required.
paper_title: Color Fundus Photography Analysis: Co-evolution of Data, Preprocessing, and Modeling toward Multimodal AI
